name: shadcn/ui Resizable Sidebar
summary: Drag-to-resize shadcn/ui sidebar with persisted width, rail-click collapse and Cmd/Ctrl+B toggle.
description: A drop-in enhancement of the shadcn/ui Sidebar that keeps its API, variants and composition model while adding drag resize from the rail, auto-collapse past a threshold, and width/collapse persistence. State restores on the server from sidebar:state and sidebar:width cookies; the demo clamps width between 14rem and 22rem.
contains: drag the rail to resize; click it to collapse or expand
auto-collapse when the rail is dragged past a threshold
width and collapse state persisted across reloads via cookies
server-side restore with sidebar:state and sidebar:width cookies
keeps the shadcn/ui Sidebar composition, variants and tokens
